data.action: 戴长手套手持羽毛假面置于颊侧，含笑凝视
data.animaCaption: Beneath a glittering crystal chandelier in a grand ballroom, she lowers an ornate feathered masquerade mask in her white opera-gloved hand and offers a confident, enigmatic smile.
data.camera: 中近景，微仰拍，背景舞会宾客虚化
data.description: 金色水晶吊灯璀璨的假面舞会大厅中，珂莱塔戴着白丝长手套轻摘羽毛假面，紫红丝绒拖尾长裙在旋转舞步间流光溢彩。
data.lighting: 水晶吊灯璀璨暖光与珠宝折射星芒
data.promptProse: Under a towering crystal chandelier at Ragunna's masquerade ball, Carlotta lowers a silver-feathered Venetian mask with a white opera-gloved hand, her plum velvet gown gleaming in the warm light.
data.title: 珂莱塔 · 拉古那假面舞会水晶吊灯下摘面具
